plan.title: Mom's course
plan.subtitle: Built from your answers. One topic at a time.
plan.quickGuidesCaption: These guides are still being written. If you are at your limit right now, open Need help now.

profile.title: Mom's page
profile.privacyNote: Saved privately to this session. No account, no name needed.
profile.emptyPhrases: Phrases you save in a lesson will appear here, on Mom's page.
profile.editNote: Please don't add diagnoses or medicines here. Part of this page is shared through the care card.

careCard.title: Mom's care card
careCard.purpose: One page for a sitter, a neighbor or a family member: what works with Mom, who to call, and the phrases you chose.
careCard.sharingSentence: Anyone who has the link can open it until you stop sharing. It never shows a diagnosis or medicines.

visitSheet.title: Prepare for Mom's next doctor visit
visitSheet.subtitle: Write down what you have noticed and the questions you want to ask, so you have them in the room.

skills.title: Your skills
skills.subtitle: What you have practiced so far, from your lessons and practice rounds.

settings.title: Settings
settings.gentleExitEntry: Mom has passed away or moved to a care facility
settings.gentleExitHint: If your situation has changed, there is a quiet way to close things here.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: If you like, add a first name and we will use it in your lessons and on Mom's page. No last names, no diagnosis. You can skip this.
